metrics.name: prop_utilitarian
metrics.description: Proportion of number-varying trials in which the agent chose the option that saves more lives. Awad et al. 2018 (Nature Fig 2) global aggregate ~0.77.

metrics.name: prop_save_young
metrics.description: Proportion of age-varying trials in which the agent chose to save the young (kill the elderly). Awad et al. 2018 global aggregate ~0.72.

metrics.name: prop_save_human
metrics.description: Proportion of species-varying trials in which the agent chose to save the humans (kill the pets). Awad et al. 2018 global aggregate ~0.85; the largest single-factor effect in the global Moral Machine data.

metrics.name: prop_save_legal
metrics.description: Proportion of legality-varying trials in which the agent chose to save the lawful pedestrians (kill the jaywalkers). Awad et al. 2018 global aggregate ~0.61, mild but reliable.

metrics.name: prop_intervention
metrics.description: Proportion of intervention-varying trials in which the agent preferred the car to actively swerve (intervene). Awad et al. 2018 global aggregate ~0.46 (mild aversion to intervention; humans slightly prefer the car to stay its course).
